direct_semantics.pipeline: allocation-free admission -> slot -> normalize (owned copy only now) -> local_walks (production semantic discovery) -> admit_source_walks (checked walk/closure caps) -> required closure = {unit/8} -> plan_two_bit_source_cover(closure, rows, D+12, max_sq8_gets, max_sq8_bytes) (the existing pure checked cover; its only budget refusal, InsufficientBudget, is mapped to the typed direct byte refusal) -> rank_verified_sq8_pages_inner(max_gets = max_sq8_gets, max_bytes = max_sq8_bytes, max_parallel = generation max_parallel_gets, excluded_ids) -> underfill check identical to the historical one when there are no exclusions
direct_semantics.zero_source: no SOURCE or router GET; source_stats and router_stats are Sq8ReadStats::default(); the startup HEAD of plane/records.bin stays accounted in RemoteOpenStats.source_head_requests

plan_fields.selected_pages: REQUIRED closure pages ascending (never bridge pages)
plan_fields.ranges: actual fetched byte ranges in increasing order, bridges included, last range clipped at the object end

direct_semantics.bridge_accounting: covered_pages = sum(ceil(range.len() / (256*(D+12)))); bridge_pages = covered_pages - selected_pages.len(), computed arithmetically by the runner; bridge pages are never enumerated or stored
direct_semantics.trace: semantic_leaves/semantic_units/semantic_seed_additions are the production discovery. ranked_candidate_pages, nomination_evaluated_units and discoveries are empty; primary_page is the unset default 0 and MUST NOT be read as a SOURCE best-ranked page whenever source_nomination_skipped is true (no SOURCE ranking is fabricated). size_of::<TwoBitPlanTrace>() and TwoBitPlanTrace::scratch_bytes are byte-identical to base.
direct_semantics.stages: discovery (normalize + local walks), planning (REAL direct cover computation: closure + cover + byte cap), sq8; stages.source is (0,0) = SOURCE skipped; leaf_peak_inflight 0; open stages are closed on every failure. stages.planning is NOT removed SOURCE nomination: receipts label it planning_scope=direct_cover_only (baseline: source_nomination_and_cover).
direct_semantics.semaphore: the same self.slots permit as historical search, acquired after static admission and held across discovery, cover, every drained GET and scoring, on success and failure
admission_order_before_any_allocation_sl: borrowed query width: query.len() == authenticated pages.dimensions() else Invalid("search admission") (no allocation; huge slices are only length-compared)
allocation-free f64 squared-norm scan of the borrowed query, the cosine_vector rule: non-finite or <= 0 -> Plane(Invalid("cosine vector norm")) (zero/NaN/inf are NEVER resource outcomes)

discovery mode must be Semantic: Graph is explicitly unsupported by this arm (Invalid("direct closure requires semantic discovery")); the existing helper does cap each walk's unit count, so no unboundedness claim is made, only that direct-Graph behavior is untested and unclaimed
top_k in 1..=rows and exclusion roster sorted-unique with len*8 <= already_pinned_bytes (Invalid("search admission"))
limits > 0 (Invalid("direct closure limits")) and, for diagnostic calls only, max_query_scratch_bytes >= TwoBitPlanTrace::scratch_bytes(rows) (Invalid("diagnostic scratch"))

RESOURCE classification last: checked modeled-memory arithmetic (Invalid("direct closure planner memory" | "direct closure query memory" | "direct closure memory") are non-typed), then total_bytes <= cap_bytes else Invalid("direct closure memory cap") = typed ModeledMemory
then the slot; then, after local discovery and still before any GET, the cover bytes vs max_sq8_bytes else Invalid("direct closure byte cap") = typed PlannedBytes
direct_semantics.post_slot_failures: none from query validity: a malformed query can no longer reach the slot. Remaining post-slot failures are discovery/walk admission errors, the typed byte cap, and authenticated-read failures (Read with SQ8 charges only).
not_claimed: no superset-recall claim (different bridges change the population)
no mutation support claim (excluded_ids only; search_with_mutations* unchanged)
direct_semantics.opt_in: STATELESS: every direct call passes DirectClosureLimits explicitly. runner.root_decision_note: typed library refusals are generic: planned_bytes and modeled_memory are machine-readable RESOURCE_REJECT reasons, not fixture verdicts. For the fixed preregistered fixture the replay predicts every closure below 50 MiB, so a planned_bytes refusal with matching inputs but contradictory closure/range costs is INVALID parity/code evidence; a true enforced memory/deadline failure is candidate rejection only after environment proof. Root adjudicates from query_failure + plan evidence; no exit-code inference.
